content: In case NvMBlockCipheringRef is given, the NvM shall before forwarding the write request to MemIf encrypt the plain data using Csm_Encrypt () with the CSM job given in NvMCsmEncryptionJobReference . The CRC calculation (if configured) shall be done over the encrypted data.
